summary: The Goshen Township Board of Zoning Appeals held a public hearing on case BZA 2026-006 regarding a dimensional variance request for an attached accessory dwelling unit (ADU) at 6317 State Route 132. The applicants, James and Elin Beeler, sought approval for a 1,053 square foot attached ADU for an 83-year-old family member with medical mobility issues, exceeding the maximum permitted ADU area of 425.75 square feet. After staff presentation, applicant testimony, and no public opposition, the board unanimously approved the variance and conditional use. Minutes from the August 17, 2026 meeting were also approved.
